theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U V M' : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (θ' : Euclid P → ℝ) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), (∀ x, 0 ≤ θ' x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k].restrict M'), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ' x) Q) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ⊆ V → T ω = ∫ x in M', θ' x * ξ' x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μHE[k]) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet W → W ⊆ V → T.massOn W ≤ ∫⁻ x in M' ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ' x) ∂μHE[k]
